motion.name: ease-out

narrative.overview: Every number on screen can show the paper it came from. Pale green-tinted security paper, a pine shell, hairline rules, small radii, a serial under every title and an ink seal beside any figure a document backs. Live component reference: the /design-system route.
keyCharacteristics: Two plies: page and one raised leaf
Same fields in the same order for every supplier
Status as word, shape and colour

rules.name: The Pressable Green Rule
rules.body: Action green appears only on things that can be pressed.

rules.name: The Roles-Only Rule
rules.body: New code uses role names, never default Tailwind colours.

rules.name: The Exact Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts come from formatSar() and are never abbreviated; profit rate with APR, never interest.

rules.name: The Two-Ply Rule
rules.body: A panel never sits inside another panel.

dos: Do use Watad's terms: offers, credit cap, neutral platform.
Do label simulated AI and sample data.
donts: Don't stamp or seal anything a simulated AI produced.
